# Echel

Echel connects a customer's phone, a print shop and its Windows-connected printers. Customers scan a shop QR code, upload documents, choose print options and pay online or at the counter.

## Product
- QR document upload and print queue.
- Windows print agent and shop owner dashboard.
- Black-and-white, colour, photo and supported large-format printing.
- English and Manipuri (Meitei Mayek) language options.
- Starter, Pro and Premium plans, plus a free demo.
- Prices, included features and billing cycles are shown on the current website. Paid plans can use monthly, quarterly, yearly or lifetime billing as configured by Echel.
